method.beats: beat_this final0 (or mean with madmom RNN, whichever grid is steadier) + madmom DBN (4/4) constrained to dance tempo +-15%, dropped/extra beats repaired
method.one_vs_five: per-bar evidence (structural novelty, energy re-entry, tonic chord, downbeat prob, accent, tonic in the bass on 8+1, 2-3 clave fit) -> 2-state Viterbi over bars with flip penalty
method.bar_phase: repaired DBN grid counted continuously; salsa bar template (bass tumbao, conga, clave, downbeat prob) scored in 16-bar windows -> Viterbi over the 4 bar phases
method.sections: Foote novelty (beat-sync MFCC+chroma+loudness) snapped to detected 1s; names are heuristic
method.breaks: >= 2 beats more than 6 dB below the 33-beat median loudness, runs <= 3 beats apart merged; single quiet beats are 'hits'

bar_phase_check.notes: bar phase = Viterbi over 16-bar windows scored by the salsa bar template (bass tumbao 2&/4, conga, clave, downbeat prob). scores[k] = whole-song match for the bar starting on our beat k+1 (0 should win). windows = [start, offset of the window's own best phase vs the chosen one]; phase_changes = where the bar phase jumps (a beat was lost/added there).

confidence.notes: margin in [-1,1]: share of 1-vs-5 evidence that agrees with the chosen alignment. 'low' means the 1 may actually be the 5 -- verify by ear.

clave.method: half-difference (counts 1-4 minus 5-8) of 1-4.5 kHz percussive onsets at 16 eighth slots vs son/rumba templates; direction relative to this JSON's counts; hits only where the clave is locally evident (not in breaks)
